cd /opt/trading-bot && sudo -u tbot venv/bin/python dryrun_ws.py 2>&1 | tail -20
echo "--- задержка до Binance (REST /time, 8 замеров):"
python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request, time, json, statistics
ts = []
for i in range(8):
    t = time.time(); d = json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.binance.com/api/v3/time", timeout=5)); t2 = time.time()
    ts.append((t2 - t) * 1000)
    srv = d["serverTime"] / 1000
    off = srv - (t + t2) / 2
print("RTT мс: мин %.0f, медиана %.0f, макс %.0f | расхождение часов с Binance около %.0f мс" % (min(ts), statistics.median(ts), max(ts), off * 1000))
PY
timedatectl 2>/dev/null | grep -i "synchronized\|NTP" | head -2
